name: Dialog
description: Modal window that asks for focus, such as a confirmation or a short form. Open it with DialogTrigger.

title.description: Heading, also used as the dialog's accessible name.

description.description: Short supporting text under the title.

role.description: Use alertdialog for destructive or urgent confirmations.

portalContainer.description: Draw the panel and its backdrop inside this element instead of over the whole page. Use it to show a sheet inside a preview, a framed app or a phone mock. The element must be positioned (relative) and clip its overflow.

headerEnd.description: Small content at the end of the header line, next to the title, such as a count.

isDismissable.description: Closes on backdrop click. Esc always closes.

children.description: Body and actions. A function receives close().

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside the dialog
requirements: Focus moves into the dialog on open and returns to the trigger on close
Content behind the dialog is hidden from assistive technology
Page scroll is locked while open
screenReader: Opening moves focus into the dialog and announces it as a dialog (alert dialog for Delete project) with its title
The description is read after the title
Browse/virtual cursor mode can't wander into the page behind the dialog
Closing announces the button that opened it (focus is back there)

use_when: A short task that must finish before continuing
avoid_when: Long or complex flows: use a page
anti_patterns: Vague buttons like 'OK' for destructive actions
